integrity: The universal operator inequalities are proved analytically; the rational checker tests finite algebra only. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula holds for nonzero subunit q and nondegenerate real-affine line segments in C(Ω), not q=0 or general higher-dimensional convex targets. Full texts of certain older q-numerical range papers were not accessible; publication priority is best-knowledge and not independently established.
title: Sharp subunit-\(q\) obstruction to segment realization by joint numerical ranges
